messages:
Maya: @channel FYI — I need to drop out tomorrow 00:00–08:00 UTC for a family emergency. I’m currently the primary and there’s no secondary assigned for the EU-midnight window. Can someone pick up primary or split coverage? The earlier noisy deploy might cause follow-on pages.

Tariq: I can take primary for 00:00–04:00 UTC. APAC +8 here so it’s late but doable. Need someone for 04:00–08:00 UTC as deputy or to take over.

Amelia: I can take 04:00–08:00. Quick Q — do we need to change canary routing before handoff? Last canary had a small error bump.

oncall-bot: Incident Bot: Current rotation: Primary=Maya, Secondary=unassigned. Escalation policy: eng-oncall/default. PagerDuty link: https://pagerduty.local/rotations/eng-oncall — Note: override exists for Maya until 1753230000. No active maintenance windows.

Maya: Thanks. Handoff checklist (quick):
1) Transfer PagerDuty rotation (example: `pd rotate --to tariq --until 1753248000`)
2) Update channel pin to include runbook + short notes
3) Post a "claimed" message in #incidents and update the runbook status
4) If pager fires, follow model-serving runbook: https://internal/runbooks/model-serving

Tariq: Done: ran `pd rotate --to tariq --until 1753248000` — got PD confirmation. I'll pin the runbook in this channel now.

Amelia: Channel pin updated, added canary status + rollback link. I’ll shadow for the first 30m after my handoff and be ready to escalate.

Ryan: for clarity — if we get a pager for `model-worker oom` follow the runbook section "OOM-heavy-worker". Quick rollback snippet I keep handy:
```
# rollback canary immediately
deployctl rollback --service model-serving --tag canary
```
Also check the logs for `gunicorn:worker` OOMs and the KV cache fill metrics.

Maya: FYI on customer impact — earlier spike produced 5xxs concentrated for acme-inc. If you see a repeat, tag @Sofia-support and open an account escalation ticket using the template linked in the runbook.

Amelia: Will do. I'll add acct-eng and @Sofia-support to the watchlist and create a follow-up ticket if >2% 5xxs for 5m.

Tariq: Confirming I'll be primary at 00:00 UTC. Pinning a tiny handoff note now. Checklist pinned:
- claimed in #incidents
- PagerDuty rotation transferred
- channel pin updated with runbook + canary status
- confirm canary traffic routing (UI: infra -> routing -> canary)
- contact list: @Amelia, @Ryan, @Sofia-support

Maya: Appreciate it — passing handoff. Close the thread once primary confirms claim and the pager rotation shows Tariq.

Tariq: Claiming primary now. I’ll be on Slack, phone available if page escalates :phone: , will hand over to Amelia at 04:00 UTC. If anyone else wants to split differently lmk now. :thumbsup:
